dev_files.description: Shree-Lipi internal font code mappings. Bytes 0x00-0x1F are identity (control codes). Bytes 0x20-0x7F map ASCII key positions to Shree-Lipi internal character codes. Bytes 0x80+ contain compose sequence data.

idv_files.description: ISCII character code mappings. Same structure as .DEV but values are standard ISCII codes (0xA0-0xFF range). This is the authoritative source for key-to-character mapping. Bytes 0x80+ contain compose sequence data.
